GapConjectures

Legendre, Brocard, Oppermann, Andrica
Proved in Lean, assuming an open conjecturering 1Gaps between survivors and between primes

Each named survivor bound implies its conjecture; Oppermann's conjecture implies both Andrica's and Legendre's, giving Legendre two independent routes.

Open conjectures it assumes (never claimed): jacobsthal_bound_holds four_survivors_bound_holds oppermann_bound_holds oppermann_conjecture
